source_snapshot.items: All HDD NVMe LED Check - Rebuild
source_snapshot.procedure: Intro requires NVMe RAID Rebuild LED; sole step inserts SSD and checks Present LED.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes Locate/raw BMC state, not Rebuild.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: All-drive scope plus three incompatible states needs owner authority and isolated vendor rebuild recovery.

old_problem: All-drive Rebuild coverage conflicts with a Present-only insertion step and a DeepSeek Locate/raw control; no per-drive rebuild-safe topology exists.
disposition_reason: The row's all-NVMe Rebuild title cannot be satisfied by one Present insertion or Locate command. Selecting any would lose the other named state and all-drive coverage. ED-01 prohibits RAID0 rebuild, and no controller-supported non-RAID0 per-member stimulus/recovery is authoritative.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row108 all18 XLSX cells and history2716.
Preserved all-applicable-drive identity rather than reducing to a single example slot.
Kept Rebuild, Present and Locate distinct and applied RAID0 prohibition; no array/LED/physical action occurred.

test_case.test_name: All-NVMe LED coverage pending Rebuild/Present/Locate state authority
test_case.purpose: After owner decision, verify the authoritative LED state for every applicable NVMe member or split the three states into separately identified variants.
required_package: Source-owner selection/split for Rebuild, Present and Locate
Vendor controller/backplane LED state table and supported CLI/version
For Rebuild: disposable redundant non-RAID0 array and exact degrade/replacement/rebuild sequence
Per-drive photos, progress/completion, abort and completion-or-rollback recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not issue raw IPMI/Locate, insert/remove members or alter an array. After state authority, apply only the approved state-specific procedure to each applicable mapped drive. A Rebuild branch must prove non-RAID0 disposable redundancy and vendor-supported member/replacement trigger, correlate controller progress with each physical LED and complete healthy recovery before proceeding to another member.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable drive shows the specified state-specific LED pattern correlated to authoritative controller evidence, and any approved rebuild restores full healthy redundancy without data/platform errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an approved state/variant and complete all-drive matrix. Present or Locate cannot pass Rebuild; one drive cannot satisfy All; RAID0 rebuild is forbidden.
safety_gate: Never rebuild RAID0, unknown or production data arrays.
No physical/member/raw command without exact serial-slot-controller identity and approval.
Require vendor command, backup, OOB and recovery before each per-drive mutation.
Abort on wrong member/state, added degradation, data/health error or failed completion; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Per-drive stable identity/topology and vendor LED table
Timestamped physical LED photos/video per drive
Final redundancy/data/health evidence and recovery disposition
test_case.recovery: On wrong state/member or incomplete rebuild, halt the remaining all-drive sequence, preserve controller/member/LED/event evidence, do not move to the next drive or force another command, and have the RAID owner execute vendor-approved completion/rollback until redundancy and data health are proven.

source_conflict.reason: All-drive Rebuild, literal Present and DeepSeek Locate remain distinct unapproved states.

blocked.reason: Owners can authorize state/split and safe per-drive procedure; execution stays prohibited meanwhile.
